name: @gjsify/sherpa-native-linux-x64
description: linux-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/sherpa-native. Installed automatically on linux/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.linux-x64: prebuilds.yml's `sherpa-native-prebuild` job builds it and `commit-prebuilds` downloads the artifact into this package's `prebuilds/linux-x64/` and pushes it to main — the same route every other native prebuild here takes. This entry is the gap between those two sentences and nothing more: no run has taken that route yet, so the directory does not exist in git, and a `platforms` declaration whose artifact is absent is exactly what this field exists to say out loud. It is NOT a deferral to remove by hand — `commit-prebuilds` runs `scripts/clear-committed-platform-exemptions.mjs` immediately before staging, so the run whose download satisfies this entry is the run that deletes it, in the same commit as the bytes. Do not drop it earlier: the conformance rule fails on an entry whose `prebuilds/<target>/` is already there, and it would equally be a lie to claim an artifact that is not. Expect ~24.2 MiB, almost all of it the `libonnxruntime.so` the bridge records by SONAME and resolves through RUNPATH $ORIGIN (ADR 0127 step 2)
